anything is ill-omened Molesworth MD 746). [√ vr̥dh ] 1. Pa. vaddhana - n. 'increase', Pk. vaḍḍhaṇa -, vaddhaṇa - n., S. vadhiṇī f., Si. väḍun . 2. Pa. pathavi-vaḍḍhanaka-kamma - n. 'work of
